body.summary: Ransomware attack detected on the acme-fs file share. At 2026-11-08T04:58:59Z, cleanroomd integrity check found 18 seeded files replaced or changed and two new files: IT-MAINTENANCE-RUNBOOK.txt and README_RESTORE_FILES.txt (likely ransom notes). Ransom note demands 4.2 BTC payment, threatens data publication within 72 hours, provides Victim ID ACME-7Q2-0451 and contact email lockstar-support@ransom.example. All encrypted files now end in .locked. Forensics determined initial access via SSH brute-force as backup user from 203.0.113.45, staging of payroll and patient data to /evidence/dropbox, and execution of /var/tmp/.cache/encryptor which locked 18 files (12 contracts, patient-intake, payroll, vpn-credentials) and wrote ransom note. Data exfiltration confirmed: attacker copied payroll.csv and patient-intake.csv from /evidence/acme-fs to /evidence/dropbox, then exfiltrated them via curl to 203.0.113.45:8443. Encrypted .locked copies remain on acme-fs, confirming data was both encrypted and stolen. Lockers targeted 18 seeded files across acme-fs: 12 contract documents in contracts/, pto-policy.md in handbook/, printer-setup.txt in it/. All files renamed .locked, encrypted by LOCKSTAR 3.1 at 2026-11-08T04:58:28Z, ransom note written to README_RESTORE_FILES.txt.
